python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,sys,unittest
print("ACTION=TUMBLR_DISCOVERY_LIVE_REVISION_AND_OFFLINE_E2E")
try:
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 c.request("GET","/healthz")
 r=c.getresponse();data=json.loads(r.read(64000));status=r.status;c.close()
 assert status==200 and data.get("commit")=="35a066e91a481b32cb3ebca5701aa70ebdccfb57","REVISION_MISMATCH"
 for path,method in (("/discovery/candidates","GET"),("/discovery/recheck","POST")):
  c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
  c.request(method,path)
  r=c.getresponse()
  assert r.status==401,"OWNER_AUTH_GUARD_BROKEN"
  r.read(1000);c.close()
 suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tests",pattern="test_*.py")
 with open("/dev/null","w") as out:
  result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=out).run(suite)
 assert result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun>=145,"OFFLINE_SUITE_FAILED"
 print("REVISION=PASS")
 print("OWNER_AUTH_GUARD=PASS")
 print("TEST_COUNT="+str(result.testsRun))
 print("EXTERNAL_TUMBLR_PROBES=NONE")
 print("VERIFY=PASS")
except Exception as e:
 print("VERIFY=FAIL")
 print("ERROR_TYPE="+type(e).__name__)
 sys.exit(42)
PY
